notes.title: What's new?
notes.content:
After the mod version was released I had several people reach out to offer help. As a result there’s a whole new set of songs from a fantastic composer. I also had a programmer reach out and offer to help port TE120 to Linux. While that may sound simple it was a mountain of work and I couldn’t have done it without his help.

So what's new:
[list]
[*]Design updates throughout & to some puzzles based on feedback from the community & valve.
[*]New story tidbits.
[*]Ported to source 2013.
[*]Added achievements!
[*]Optimization (5-15 fps improvement in most scenes).
[*]Tons of polish & bug fixes!
[/list]

I hope you enjoy it and please post your reviews on the store page here when you're done.
